Sources and data attribution

SXS:BBH:0305, our QC0 simulations and Yitian’s SXS:BBH:0389 data have separate provenance. Their parameters and definitions are not mixed.

Sources, conventions and checksums

The original author-supplied correspondence archive and large raw grids are not included. The required B4 input is retained for B5. Documentation explicitly states the completeness of each reproduction route.
